coverageNotes: Does not test authorization, cascades, or missing-user policy. Both current table-scoped and valid legacy signatures exist; only the displayed table-scoped shapes are compared.

questions.concept: Deleting by a validated document ID
questions.question: Which call compiles and deletes the user with this ID?

options.rationale: The second argument is the ID itself, not an object containing the document system field.
delete takes one document ID, not an array of IDs.
The table-scoped delete call accepts the validated users ID directly.
delete does not accept an options object containing id.
